summary: Premortem de obsolescencia tecnológica (24 meses), postmortem de incidentes, propuestas de mejora controladas y puerta de promoción con aprobación explícita.
invariants: JANUS CORE remains authoritative: module never calls a remote provider, changes code, updates dependencies or deploys.
An absent, unverified or stale check is UNKNOWN, never PASS.
Evidence must identify a verifiable test, immutable receipt or official source.
Repeated incidents escalate and mandate review of prior preventive protection.
All proposal outputs require human approval and rollback evidence before promotion.
Designed to run offline with caller-provided observations and timestamps; state persistence belongs to Janus Core SQLite.
Changes to limits/cadence require versioned policy, not hardcoded personal circumstances.
reuseNotes: Import premortem, postmortem, proposeUpgrade, assessReleaseGate from src/index.ts; the host owns evidence acquisition, audit persistence in SQLite and approvals. API may expose summary only to authenticated Founder.
